ValidationRule.description: While changing the record type we need to make 'Primary Product Line' as respective to the Record Type(CPQ Sales Opportunity).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( AND( OR( $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = 'Opportunity', $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = '' ), NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c) ),IF( AND(ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId),RecordType.DeveloperName ='CPQ_Sales_Opportunity'), If(OR( ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "SMB Packages"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Records Management"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Data Management"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Scan"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Shred"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Special Projects - Records Management & Shred"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Special Projects - Data Management"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Special Projects - International") ),false,true),false), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select the CPQ related 'Primary Product Line'
